# AI Coding Video

> A style library and Agent Skill (SKILL.md) for making videos by having an AI coding agent write code: every frame is rendered deterministically from time t. Frames are drawn by code (class C), or code edits public-domain / CC0 footage (class T) or AI-generated material (class G). Documentation is in Chinese; this page is bilingual.

- Repository: https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video
- Install for Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video` then `claude plugin install ai-coding-video@ai-coding-video`
- License: MIT

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/README.md): what it is, install for Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/skills/ai-coding-video/SKILL.md): instructions the agent follows; two tracks: a style demo (pick a look, a sample, a style pack) or a full film
- [Style index](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/skills/ai-coding-video/index.md): all styles by topic, content type, purpose, mood, platform
- [Making samples](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/skills/ai-coding-video/making.md): render pipeline (browser frames, Playwright, ffmpeg)
- [Full film](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/skills/ai-coding-video/film.md): the second track: content, storyboard and looks, script, sign-off, a narrated typical segment, the whole film
- [Materials](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/skills/ai-coding-video/materials.md): classes C, T, G and material rules

## Examples

- [Samples](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/tree/main/samples): reproducible render code per style, 16:9 and 9:16
- [Style packs](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/packs/README.md): reusable, re-brandable code modules
- [Case studies](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/cases/README.md): complete ~5-minute videos with storyboard, code, time and cost
